clean_methods: Context: To test whether co-tuned auditory-cortex ensembles rebalance activity, the plan uses the following method: 'employ an all-optical approach combining in vivo two-photon calcium imaging with holographic optogenetic stimulation to manipulate and monitor neuronal activity at single-cell resolution in awake mice.'

Context: To enable simultaneous readout and manipulation of the same neurons, the plan uses the following method: 'use a custom AAV vector (AAV9-hSyn-GCaMP8s-T2A-rsChRmine) that co-expresses the calcium indicator GCaMP8s and the red-shifted opsin rsChRmine, allowing simultaneous imaging and optogenetic manipulation.'

Context: To isolate the effect of activating a small frequency-specific population, the plan uses the following method: 'precisely targeting small ensembles (5 cells) of neurons sharing the same frequency preference while monitoring the responses of all other neurons in the field of view.'

Context: To test whether activating co-tuned neurons suppresses other co-tuned neurons, the plan uses the following method: 'repeat the same tone presentations while simultaneously applying holographic optogenetic stimulation to five pre-selected target neurons (100 ms stimulation duration, 5 mW per cell, 15 μm spiral pattern, 30 revolutions).'

Context: To identify frequency-tuned neurons before manipulation, the plan uses the following method: 'present pure tones at three frequencies (4, 16, and 54 kHz, 100 ms duration, 2-second inter-stimulus intervals, 10 repeats each) to identify frequency-tuned neurons and select target ensembles for stimulation.'

Context: To provide a pre-stimulation reference for all imaged neurons, the plan uses the following method: 'record baseline responses to 16 kHz and 54 kHz pure tones (100 ms duration, 5.8-6.5 second inter-stimulus intervals, 30 trials each in random order) to establish pre-stimulation response properties of all imaged neurons.'
Context: To distinguish optogenetic effects from sound adaptation, the plan uses the following method: 'include a control condition where we perform identical procedures but with 0 mW laser power.'

Context: To assess whether stimulation-induced changes are persistent, the plan uses the following method: 'present the same tone series without stimulation to assess whether any observed changes persist after the manipulation period.'

Context: To quantify network-level effects of ensemble activation, the plan uses the following method: 'measure tone-evoked responses as changes in fluorescence (ΔF/F) and quantify stimulation effects by comparing response amplitudes between sessions.'

Context: To test whether rebalancing is frequency-specific, the plan uses the following method: 'categorize neurons based on their frequency preferences and analyze how co-tuned versus non-co-tuned populations respond to target ensemble stimulation.'

Context: To infer the spatial and temporal mechanism of rebalancing, the plan uses the following method: 'examine the spatial distribution of affected neurons and the temporal dynamics of any observed changes to understand the underlying mechanisms.'

Context: To verify that holographic stimulation is localized to intended cells, the plan uses the following method: 'conduct control experiments varying stimulation position relative to target cells and measuring response decay with distance.'

Context: To verify that the intended five-cell ensembles are reliably activated, the plan uses the following method: 'test the reliability of multi-cell stimulation by assessing the proportion of successfully activated target neurons across trials.'
